equity_bridge.item: Cushman & Wakefield plc listed shares (FVOCI, at fair value)
equity_bridge.note: Interim balance sheet 30 Jun 2026, 'Equity investments designated at FVOCI' 961.6 (FY2025 AR note 19: the only holding is Cushman & Wakefield plc, listed; 1,192.7 at Dec-2025). Marked to market by definition. C&W pays no dividend, so no income to strip from the flows.

Book 2,895.4 at 30 Jun 2026 (2,518.0 at Dec-2025). Mainly parking spaces and other assets taken from China Vanke Group and its JVs in settlement of receivables (interim note 'Purchases of investment properties ... related to debt settlement transactions', 378.7 in H1 FY2026 alone; >RMB3bn of assets taken in lieu since 2024). Priced by reference to historical transaction amounts, so realisable value is uncertain; disposals are tiny (78.5 in H1 FY2026, at a 12.6 gain). 40% haircut for illiquidity and transfer pricing. Their rental income is small and left inside the flows.

equity_bridge.item: Investments in joint ventures and associates at 50% of book
equity_bridge.note: Book 1,236.5 at 30 Jun 2026, earning roughly nothing (share of results -10.8 FY2025, +3.4 H1 FY2026; dividends received 8.9 in H1 FY2026). 50% haircut; the near-zero share of profit is left in the flows (immaterial).
Interim balance sheet 30 Jun 2026. Charged once here; flows are consolidated.

Judgment: roughly one month of cash operating costs (FY2025 cost of sales + opex ~35bn/yr) retained against RMB5.0bn of contract liabilities (prepaid owner fees) and 6.0bn of other payables. The 9.37bn cash figure is a June trough but a labour-intensive manager running 12bn/yr of wages cannot run on zero. Deducted so that only genuinely surplus cash is credited.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: H1 FY2026 revenue +5.4% and FY2025 +2.7%, below the 3-yr revenue CAGR of 7.4%; residential +6.5% and facility management +8.9% offset by developer VAS -19% and BPaaS/AIoT -10%. Equity CAGR is negative (dividends + buybacks exceed earnings) and is not a growth proxy here.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3-yr CAGR -3.9% diverges from revenue 3-yr CAGR +7.4% and EPS 3-yr CAGR -24.6% by far more than 30%: book value is shrinking because payouts (2.1-2.4bn/yr dividends plus buybacks) exceed attributable profit (0.69bn FY2025), while revenue still grows and EPS has collapsed on impairments. Growth is taken from revenue, not equity.
historical_growth.notes: History starts FY2021 (IPO Sep-2022), so 5-year CAGRs are not computable; 4-year figures (FY2021->FY2025) are given instead and the 4-yr equity CAGR is distorted by the 2022 IPO proceeds. Owner FCF = reported FCF less the IFRS 16 lease cash charge (~110-135/yr); SBC nil throughout; interest received is outside OCF for this filer. Owner-FCF 3-yr CAGR (-13.9%) is slightly worse than reported (-12.6%) only because of the lease charge; the real story is reported FCF falling from 2.30bn (FY2022) to 1.53bn (FY2025) as receivables went unpaid and were impaired.

scenario_narratives.base: Onewo keeps growing the recurring book (residential +6-7%, facility management +8-9%) while it prunes developer-linked and loss-making projects, so group revenue compounds at 5% fading to 2.5%. Gross margin settles around 12% and the AI/hybrid-staffing programme holds the admin ratio, leaving pre-impairment EBITDA near 8%. Receivables impairment, the swing line, falls from 3.1% of revenue (TTM, with the H2 FY2025 RMB0.9bn related-party charge) to ~1% by year 4 as the developer book (now ~5% of revenue) is run off and Vanke's cash flow is bridged by Shenzhen Metro. Cash taxes stay above 25% because ECL provisions and acquired-intangible amortisation are not deductible. The company remains debt-free; the 15x-plus Gordon value is capped at 12x terminal FCF for a structurally price-competitive industry.
scenario_narratives.bull: Industry consolidation (management expects providers to fall from the 100,000s to the 10,000s) plays to Onewo's 70% residential win rate; 'Onewo Town' density and the Lingshi/GC AI platform lift pre-impairment EBITDA to 9.5%; home-related asset services (repair +45-67%) and energy management add a growth leg; developer receivables are worked out with limited further loss as Vanke stabilises. Revenue grows 7% fading to 3%, impairment settles below 1% of revenue, and the business converts ~5% of revenue to owner FCF.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 'Warring States' phase of Chinese property management persists: 10-15 bidders per tender, falling fees per square metre, rising vacancy and a collection rate that has fallen four years running push gross margin toward 11%. Vanke's liquidity does not recover: the remaining RMB0.8bn net related-party and RMB0.7bn non-related developer receivables, plus parking spaces taken in lieu, are progressively written down (impairment 3% of revenue in year 1, still 1.5% in the terminal year) and cash taxes stay high on non-deductible provisions. Growth stalls at 2%; owner FCF margin ~2.5-3%. The business survives (net cash, no debt) but earns a low return; the pledged 52% stake to Shenzhen Metro adds change-of-control uncertainty the DCF cannot price.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value Onewo as a debt-free, SBC-free fee business whose cash earnings are obscured by non-cash impairments and amortisation: owner FCF (RMB1.4-1.5bn) is roughly double attributable profit (RMB0.69bn FY2025). The valuation is therefore driven by three judgments - how far receivables impairment normalises, whether gross margin has bottomed, and how much of the RMB9.4bn June cash pile and the RMB5bn of non-operating assets (C&W shares, Vanke-sourced parking spaces, JVs) is really surplus. Each is handled explicitly: impairment inside the EBITDA path per scenario, a 12x terminal cap for a structurally slow industry, haircuts on the Vanke-sourced assets and a RMB2.5bn operating float deducted from cash. Vanke counterparty and governance risk is charged once, through the flows and a 30% bear weight, not through the discount rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: Further write-downs of developer receivables (RMB1.5bn net at 50%+ ECL) and of the RMB2.9bn of investment properties taken from Vanke in lieu of cash
Gross margin has fallen from ~17% to ~12% in four years; the base assumes it stabilises near 12%, which the H1 FY2026 decline (13.7% -> 12.7%) does not yet confirm
Capital allocation under a distressed 52% owner: dividends (RMB2.1-2.4bn/yr) exceed FCF and attributable profit, and asset-for-debt swaps convert cash-like receivables into illiquid parking spaces
Change of control: Vanke's entire Onewo stake is pledged to Shenzhen Metro; enforcement would hand control to a state entity with different priorities
Cash-tax rate: ECL provisions and acquired-intangible amortisation are non-deductible; if impairments stay high the effective cash rate stays near 40% on a smaller EBIT
Deferred-fee float: RMB5.0bn of contract liabilities are owner prepayments; a larger operating-cash requirement than the RMB2.5bn assumed would reduce surplus cash one-for-one

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (regular session); 52-week range 14.63-23.90 HKD
data_sources.financials: research/2602.HK/Reports/2602.HK_Metrics.csv (FY2021-H1 FY2026, RMB m) and the filings in research/2602.HK/Extracted: 2602.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt (income statement line 8110ff, cash flow 8527-8560, D&A note 12525, RoU depreciation 13330, FVOCI note 13731), 2602.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt (segment table 859-885, receivables MD&A 1666-1732, liquidity 1846-1874, balance sheet 3224-3256, cash flow 3511-3550, share capital 4684-4706, related-party note 4764-4830)

inputs.base_revenue_note: TTM to 30 Jun 2026 = FY2025 37,271.9 + H1 FY2026 19,112.4 - H1 FY2025 18,137.5 (RMB m). FY0 is the trailing twelve months so the revenue base, the balance sheet and the share count all sit on the same 30 Jun 2026 date; year 1 is the twelve months to Jun-2027.
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,152,667,229 shares in issue at 30 Jun 2026 less 15,385,900 treasury shares held by the Company (interim report note 15) = 1,137,281,329. Basic EPS = diluted EPS in every period and the filings disclose no share option or share award scheme, so there are no dilutive securities. Held FLAT: SBC is zero and buybacks are value-neutral in this model.
inputs.cash_note: Cash and cash equivalents 9,301.9 + time deposits with original maturity over three months 66.9 at 30 Jun 2026 (interim note 14). Restricted bank deposits of 997.7 are EXCLUDED (guarantee/pledged deposits, not free cash). Bank borrowings nil ('no bank loans or borrowings' at 30 Jun 2026). Lease liabilities 233.4 are excluded from net debt because leases are charged inside the flows (treatment B). June is the seasonal cash trough (H1 OCF is negative every year on fee-collection timing); the Dec-2025 balance was 11,084.8. An operating-cash float is deducted separately in equity_bridge.
inputs.fcf_note: FY2025 reported FCF = OCF 1,689.8 - capex 155.9 (PPE 117.9 + intangibles 38.0). last_fcf equals reported_fcf because SBC is nil and interest received is classified in INVESTING activities by this filer (HKAS 7), so reported OCF/FCF already exclude interest income; deducting it again would double-count. The lease cash charge (~132/yr principal + interest) is applied in the forward flows via lease_cost_pct_path, so the modelled FY0 owner FCF is ~1,400. TTM-Jun-2026 reported FCF was only 881.6 (OCF 1,036.3 - capex 154.7) because H1 FY2026 OCF of -1,027.9 absorbed a one-off acceleration of supplier payments (interim MD&A); the component build, not this figure, drives year 1.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report and H1 FY2026 interim report: no share option, share award or share incentive scheme disclosed; no share-based payment expense line; no SBC add-back in the cash flow statement; basic and diluted EPS identical. SBC-zero filer - house and street bases coincide and band_position is null by construction.
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest income was RMB39.5m in FY2025 and 7.3m in H1 FY2026 (interim CF: 'Interest received' in investing). It is NOT in reported OCF/FCF, hence 0 in the deduction above. It IS inside 'Other income and gains' on the income statement, so it has been stripped from every EBITDA margin used in the build (TTM EBITDA 2,030.0 is ex-interest). The cash pile is therefore counted once, in net debt.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow 'Shares repurchased' 133.7 (5.80m shares); H1 FY2026 25.7 (2.27m shares). Board approved up to RMB500m from Nov-2025. Buybacks are value-neutral here (SBC-zero, flat count).
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. fx_rate = 1.1749 HKD per CNY (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-22T02:05Z), applied model -> quote: RMB per-share values x 1.1749 = HKD. No dual listing exists for a parity check; cross-check: the 2026 interim dividend of RMB0.711 was declared payable in HKD at the PBOC-published rate, which was ~1.17 in Aug-2026, consistent with direction and magnitude.
inputs.wacc_rationale: WACC built in CNY, the currency of the flows: CNY 10-year government bond ~1.8%; China equity risk premium ~5.5% (mature-market 4.3% + ~1.2% country premium); beta ~1.1 for HK-listed China property managers; cost of equity ~7.9%, rounded UP to 9.0% to reflect a single-A-share-type governance structure (52% owner pledged to Shenzhen Metro, continuing connected transactions) and the thinner liquidity of the H-share. No debt, so WACC = cost of equity. The same 9.0% is used in all three scenarios: Vanke counterparty risk is charged ONCE, in the flows and the 30% bear weight, not again through per-scenario discount rates.
inputs.lease_treatment: B - leases as operating cost. The full IFRS 16 lease cash charge (capital element 62.2 + interest element 4.0 in H1 FY2026, ~132/yr, 0.35% of revenue) is deducted inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (233.4 at 30 Jun 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt; D&A for cash-tax EBIT is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 D&A 1,048.5 less RoU depreciation 117.8 = 930.7, 2.5% of revenue). Short-term lease payments not capitalised (103.1 in FY2025) are already inside opex.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are modelled on a consolidated basis; non-controlling interests (RMB870.1m book at 30 Jun 2026; NCI share of profit 77.0 in FY2025, 38.4 in H1 FY2026, i.e. 5-10% of group profit) are deducted ONCE, at book value, in equity_bridge. Book is a fair proxy: NCI earns ~9% on book, close to the cost of equity.
inputs.ebitda_definition: EBITDA = gross profit + other income and gains (ex interest income) - selling & distribution - administrative expenses - net impairment losses on financial assets + depreciation & amortisation (post-IFRS 16, i.e. before the lease charge the engine deducts separately). Impairment of trade and other receivables is treated as a RECURRING operating cost of serving developer and owner customers, not a one-off. History: FY2024 7.5% (pre-impairment 9.2%, impairment 1.7%); FY2025 5.5% (pre-impairment 8.7%, impairment 3.2%); H1 FY2025 8.9%; H1 FY2026 8.2% (pre-impairment 9.6%, impairment 1.4%); TTM Jun-2026 5.3% (pre-impairment 8.4%, impairment 3.1%). Gross margin trend: ~17% FY2021 -> 12.2% FY2025 -> 12.7% H1 FY2026 (13.7% H1 FY2025).
inputs.cash_tax_note: PRC statutory 25%. Cash tax paid runs well above the P&L charge because expected-credit-loss provisions are not deductible until written off and the amortisation of acquired customer relationships (~500m/yr inside D&A) is largely non-deductible: cash tax / PBT was 21% FY2021, 26% FY2022, 19% FY2023, 40% FY2024, 56% FY2025; on the modelled EBIT (after impairment, ex-RoU D&A) FY2024 was ~38%. The paths start at 34% (base) and ease toward 30% as impairments normalise and the acquired-intangible amortisation runs off; the bear holds a higher rate because the same non-deductibles sit on a smaller EBIT.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (owner_fcf_dcf_component), fresh build, no prior DCF or memory entry. Routing: Onewo is an asset-light operating services company (property management, facility management, BPaaS) earning fees - not a REIT, bank, LIC or holdco. Its NAV-like features (RMB2.9bn of investment properties, mostly parking spaces taken from Vanke in debt-for-asset settlements; a RMB0.96bn listed stake in Cushman & Wakefield plc; RMB1.24bn of JVs/associates) are non-operating and are handled through the equity bridge with haircuts, not by switching models. Receivables risk (gross trade receivables 8,854 with a 20.9% ECL; related-party developer receivables 1.6bn gross at a 50.6% ECL; non-related developers 1.39bn at 51.8%) is modelled as an impairment line inside the EBITDA margin path, heaviest in the bear case. Price is a live regular-session print. Currency: CNY flows, HKD quote, fx_rate 1.1749. Leases treatment B. NCI in bridge. Interest income stripped from the EBITDA build and counted once in net cash. Terminal cap 12x FCF for a structurally slow, price-competitive industry. The Analysis JSON (2026-10-22) was read and its bull/bear axes drive the scenario narratives.

bear.ebitda_margin_note: Gross margin keeps compressing toward 11% (red-ocean tenders, vacancy >30% in some delivered communities, collection rate below 71%), pre-impairment EBITDA 7.8% -> 7.0%; impairment stays elevated at 3.0% -> 2.5% -> 2.0% -> 1.5% of revenue as the remaining ~1.5bn net developer receivables and assets taken in lieu are written down.

base.ebitda_margin_note: Pre-impairment EBITDA drifts from 8.4% (TTM) to 8.0% as gross margin pressure (12.7% -> ~12%) is only partly offset by AI/hybrid-staffing admin savings and loss-making project exits; impairment of receivables normalises 2.0% -> 1.5% -> 1.2% -> 1.0% of revenue (FY2024 1.7%, FY2025 3.2%, H1 FY2026 1.4% annualised) as developer-linked revenue (5% of total) keeps shrinking.
base.da_pct_note: Ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 930.7 = 2.5% of revenue; TTM ~2.35%). Declines as the amortisation of acquired customer relationships (~500m/yr, intangibles 7.2bn incl. goodwill) runs off and bolt-on M&A slows.
base.capex_pct_note: PPE + intangibles purchases: 1.5% FY2022, 1.1% FY2023, 0.7% FY2024, 0.4% FY2025 and TTM. Lifted toward 0.7% so that D&A ex-amortisation is not permanently out-running reinvestment (Lingshi edge servers, robotics).
base.wc_capture_note: Growth consumes a little cash: receivables (59 days) grow with revenue and collection rates are falling, partly funded by contract liabilities (prepaid fees, 13% of revenue). With impairments already inside EBITDA, the residual WC drag was -115 (FY2024) to +200 (FY2025) on ~1-2bn of revenue growth.

bull.ebitda_margin_note: Pre-impairment EBITDA recovers to 9.5% (admin ratio keeps falling with AI 'digital employees', elastic pricing holds gross margin ~13%, loss-making projects exited); impairment 1.5% -> 1.0% -> 0.8% as the developer book is run off and Vanke stabilises under Shenzhen Metro.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: the controlling shareholder is in acknowledged distress (Fitch 'restricted default' territory, repeated Shenzhen Metro loans, entire Onewo stake pledged), the H2 FY2025 impairment produced a loss half, the related-party ECL rate jumped 38.5pp in a year to 50.6%, and >RMB3bn of receivables have been settled in illiquid assets rather than cash - a single-counterparty dependency that is the method's trigger for a 25-35% bear weight. Bull trimmed to 20% because it needs several independent things to go right at once (margin recovery in a price-cutting industry, Vanke stabilisation, and the new service lines scaling). Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
